Name: Werewolf in the Valley
Author: Platonymous
Description:
[center][heading]Werewolf in the valley[/heading] by Platonymous
[line]
Play a game of Werewolf while playing SDV.

[size=1]Generally Werewolf is more fun with more people, but SDV Multiplayer is limited, so you should probably try one of the mods or methods to increase the player/cabin limit.
 (eg: [url=https://twitter.com/concernedape/status/1395243158460530689?lang=en]https://twitter.com/concernedape/status/1395243158460530689?lang=en[/url]﻿)
There are bots included, but they aren't the brightest and don't talk, so not great for a discussion based game.
Having voice chat with the other players would also be highly recommended. 

[/size][img]https://imgur.com/T5Eybda.png[/img]
[b]To start the game, examine the upper left gravestone in town.[/b]
(In Multiplayer only the HOST can start a game)

Most of the game is played in Dialog, but the [u]Ingame Actions[/u] (kill, poison, see) are performed by going next to a character and pressing the action button.
(in the config file, default is [u]K[/u])

A letter shows the current state of the game. It appears automaticaly throughout but can also be displayed by pressing the notes key.
(in the config file, default is [u]N[/u])

After the game was started by the gravestone, the wolfes can go out an kill, as well as the other roles do their Ingame Actions.
At the beginning of each new day,[u] if the werwolves have killed someone (or at least tried)[/u] votes are held and the players decide who should be executed.

Every Player ist tied to a specific villager in town. Ingame Actions can be performed on both the farmer or the villager, to the same effect.

[b]Included roles:
[/b]
[b]Villager:[/b]
Normal Villager

[b]Werewolf:[/b]
The Werewolves can kill one villager every round. With more than one Werewolf it's first come first kill. [u](Ingame Action)[/u]

[b]Witch:[/b]
Can save a villager from beieng killed by wolves once
Can poison a villager once [u](Ingame Action)

[/u][b]Seer:[/b]
Can check if someone is a villager or werewolf, one check per round (Ingame Action)

[b]Amor:[/b]
Picks two players who receive the "Lover" role

[b]Lover:
[/b]If one of the two Lovers dies, so does the other one.

[b]Mayor:
[/b]Decides who should be executed in case of a tie.

[b]Judge:[/b]
Can not vote himself, but decides who gets executed out of all the players that had received at least one vote.
Unless he receives the most votes, then he's dead.

(A game can only have either a mayor or a judge, and if they die the player holding the role gets to decide who succeed them)
